hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); echo "$path" | grep -qE 'crates/[a-z0-9_]+_runtime/src/' && { echo 'BLOCKED: edits to crates/*_runtime/src/ are prohibited (Plan E runtime lockdown). Express the change as a .sim or compiler primitive instead. Bypass with RUNTIME_EDIT_JUSTIFIED=1 in your shell env if this is a mechanical compiler-driven update.' >&2; [ "$RUNTIME_EDIT_JUSTIFIED" = '1' ] && exit 0 || exit 2; } || exit 0
